checked_and_survived: The receipt of 2,000 USDC is classified as income from the transfer of a virtual digital asset, taxed at 30% under s.115BBH. The value is determined on the settlement date (2026-06-23) using the telegraphic transfer buying rate. No TDS is required as the recipient is outside India. Under s.439(8), a bona fide disclosure of the income with all material facts is required to avoid penalties.
limits: Information on whether the SBI telegraphic transfer buying rate is the prescribed rate for valuing USDC for income tax purposes in FY 2026-27 was not available.
